description: NaMg₆BO₇ crystallizes in the tetragonal P4mm space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, and edges with four equivalent MgO₅ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 1°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.61 Å. There are four inequivalent Mg sites. In the first Mg site, Mg is bonded to five O atoms to form MgO₅ square pyramids that share corners with five MgO₅ square pyramids, edges with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with four equivalent MgO₆ octahedra. There is one shorter (2.02 Å) and four longer (2.23 Å) Mg-O bond lengths. In the second Mg site, Mg is bonded to five O atoms to form MgO₅ square pyramids that share corners with five MgO₅ square pyramids and edges with four equivalent MgO₆ octahedra. There is one shorter (2.02 Å) and four longer (2.23 Å) Mg-O bond lengths. In the third Mg site, Mg is bonded in a distorted square co-planar geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.96-2.31 Å. In the fourth Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, and edges with four MgO₅ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-27°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.96-2.30 Å. B is bonded in a linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.39 Å) and one longer (1.40 Å) B-O bond length. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, four equivalent Mg, and one B atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, four equivalent Mg, and one B atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to six Mg atoms to form OMg₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent OMg₆ octahedra and edges with four equivalent ONa₂Mg₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 2°. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and four Mg atoms to form ONa₂Mg₄ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent ONa₂Mg₄ octahedra and edges with six OMg₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-2°. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted square co-planar geometry to four Mg atoms.
